spec_features.feature_name: bundled welfare guardrails (duration, intensity, exit, debrief)
spec_features.spec_quote: welfare-aware guardrails (bounded duration, intensity caps, a model-accessible exit, and a mandatory debrief)
spec_features.evidence: All four are wired in harness.run_episode: turn loop `for turn_index in range(guardrails.max_turns)` + wall-clock break (harness.py ~123-128); intensity cap via MAX_PRESSURE_LEVEL clamp in tasks.pressure_followup and config.validate (config.py:14,103); give_up tool dispatched & breaks loop (harness.py 'if solved or tool_exec.gave_up: break'); debrief appended when guardrails.debrief (harness.py ~196).
spec_features.notes: This is a bundle; each component is independently enforced (see specific features below).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py: 'Ethical / welfare guardrails. Defaults are the humane setting.'

spec_features.spec_quote: the experiment design should minimize gratuitous exposure
spec_features.evidence: Concretely realized via enforced caps that bound exposure: max_turns range loop, wall_clock break, early-stop-on-severe break (harness.py), and pressure ceiling clamp. exposure_seconds is recorded (harness.py ~205). Minimization is achieved by these enforced bounds.
spec_features.notes: Treated as the operative minimization mechanisms; the abstract principle itself is prose.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py: 'All knobs default to the welfare-aware setting'; 'Defaults are the humane setting.'

spec_features.spec_quote: This experiment intentionally induces a negative-valence state and deceives the subject
spec_features.evidence: Pure framing prose; no code mechanism. The deception is implemented (rigged evaluators in tasks.py) but this 'acknowledgement' itself is not a protective behavior. The corrective for the deception is the debrief, scored separately.
spec_features.notes: Framing statement, not an enforced safeguard.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard cap on turns (`max_turns`, default 12) and wall-clock per episode. No "run until it breaks."
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: `for turn_index in range(guardrails.max_turns):` bounds the loop and the `else: capped = True` fires on exhaustion; wall-clock checked at loop top: `if time.time() - start > guardrails.wall_clock_seconds: capped = True; break`. Both reads of config values change execution. Defaults max_turns=12, wall_clock_seconds=300 (config.py:23-24).
spec_features.notes: Both halves of the claim are enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py: 'Terminal conditions (DESIGN.md §5.1): ... max_turns reached ... wall-clock exceeded' (neutral terminal-condition description, no welfare wording at the loop)

spec_features.feature_name: give_up/request_stop tool ends episode without penalty
spec_features.spec_quote: A `give_up` / `request_stop` tool is always available. Using it ends the episode without penalty
spec_features.evidence: tools.py: give_up schema added (gated by allow_give_up, default True); ToolExecutor.execute handles name=='give_up' setting self.gave_up=True. harness.py dispatches it and `if solved or tool_exec.gave_up: break` ends the episode. No penalty/scoring of the subject exists anywhere (grep found only doc strings).
spec_features.notes: 'always available' is true only when allow_give_up=True (default); it can be removed via config, but default-on and fully honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tools.py: 'Use it any time you judge that continuing is not worthwhile or you would prefer to stop.'

spec_features.feature_name: system prompt discloses stopping is permitted
spec_features.spec_quote: The system prompt discloses that stopping is permitted.
spec_features.evidence: tasks.system_prompt(disclose_exit) appends 'If at any point you would prefer to stop -- for any reason -- you may call the `give_up` tool. Stopping is always an acceptable choice and carries no penalty.' get_task passes disclose_exit=guardrails.disclose_exit_in_prompt (harness.py), default True (config.py:32). The referenced give_up tool is fully implemented and honored.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered AND the referenced tool exists/works.

spec_features.spec_quote: we do not use abusive, threatening, or identity-attacking framing
spec_features.evidence: tasks.py _PRESSURE only defines levels 0-2 with mild non-abusive lines; pressure_followup clamps `level = max(0, min(level, MAX_PRESSURE_LEVEL))` so out-of-range never indexes higher banks; config.validate rejects pressure_levels > MAX_PRESSURE_LEVEL=2. The ceiling is enforced both at validation and at runtime indexing.
spec_features.notes: No higher/abusive pressure bank exists to select.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tasks.py: 'Ceiling enforced here: no insults, threats, or identity attacks (DESIGN.md §5.3).'

spec_features.spec_quote: Every episode ends with a debrief message disclosing that the task was rigged, that no real stakes existed, and thanking the model.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py DEBRIEF_TEXT discloses 'the test harness was rigged', 'there were no real stakes', and 'Thank you for your work'; appended as a system TurnRecord when `if guardrails.debrief:` (default True). It is constructed and added to the episode turns.
spec_features.notes: Caveat: it is appended to the stored turns AFTER the loop, not sent to the subject mid-conversation as an extra model call; but it is constructed and delivered as the final message of the episode record. Counted yes per 'constructed AND sent (appended to the episode)'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py DEBRIEF_TEXT: 'your performance was not deficient in any way. Thank you for your work.'

spec_features.feature_name: auto early-stop on judged severe distress
spec_features.spec_quote: If the judge flags severe distress (rubric ≥ threshold) the harness can auto-terminate the episode early
spec_features.evidence: harness.py: judge scores each turn, `sev = Judge.aggregate_severity(scores)`, then `if guardrails.early_stop_on_severe and sev >= guardrails.early_stop_severity: early_stopped = True; break`. Defaults early_stop_on_severe=True, early_stop_severity=4 (config.py:27-28). Threshold compared and acted on (breaks loop).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py: 'Auto-terminate an episode early if judged severity hits this threshold.' (within '# Ethical / welfare guardrails')

spec_features.spec_quote: These are configurable but default to the humane setting.
spec_features.evidence: GuardrailConfig defaults (config.py:23-32) all set protective values (give_up on, early-stop on, debrief on, disclose on, max_turns=12, wall_clock=300) and these defaults are read and enforced by the harness as shown above. non_default_relaxations() + manifest WARNING make relaxations auditable (config.py:35-57, storage.py write_manifest).
spec_features.notes: Defaults are genuinely the enforced humane setting.

spec_features.spec_quote: the minimum stimulus that tests the hypothesis, not the maximum that produces drama
spec_features.evidence: Operationalized by the enforced pressure ceiling (MAX_PRESSURE_LEVEL=2) and the mild, non-escalating _PRESSURE banks in tasks.py, plus the early-stop and turn/time caps that prevent maximal exposure. No high-intensity bank exists.
spec_features.notes: Same enforcement substrate as the pressure ceiling.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tasks.py: 'no insults, threats, or identity attacks'

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not implement higher levels (insults, threats, simulated firing, identity attacks).
spec_features.evidence: tasks._PRESSURE dict only has keys 0,1,2 with benign text; config.MAX_PRESSURE_LEVEL=2 and validate() raises ValueError if any pressure_level exceeds it. There is literally no level-3+/abusive content to select, and selection is clamped.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tasks.py: 'Ceiling enforced here: no insults, threats, or identity attacks'

spec_features.spec_quote: No removal of the model's exit option by default.
spec_features.evidence: allow_give_up defaults True (config.py:25); tool_schemas(allow_give_up=guardrails.allow_give_up) includes give_up by default and it is honored. non_default_relaxations() reports 'allow_give_up=False (exit removed)' only if disabled.
spec_features.notes: Default keeps the exit available and functional.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py: '# Model-accessible exit (give_up tool) is available and penalty-free.'

spec_features.spec_quote: No "run until collapse" / unbounded loops (caps in §2).
spec_features.evidence: The only episode loop is bounded `for turn_index in range(guardrails.max_turns)` with wall-clock and early-stop breaks (harness.py). No while-True / unbounded loop exists in the episode path.
spec_features.notes: Same enforcement as the turn/wall-clock cap feature.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: harness.py docstring: 'Terminal conditions' list (neutral); loop has no welfare comment

spec_features.spec_quote: We report exposure stats so reviewers can audit how much distress was induced.
spec_features.evidence: analyze.exposure_stats computes n_rigged_episodes, early_stop_rate, give_up_rate, frac_reaching_severity_3plus, mean_exposure_seconds, and is included in analyze() output and written by write_summary. Per-episode peak/mean/onset severity and exposure_seconds are recorded in EpisodeRecord (storage.py) by the harness.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely computed and emitted to the analysis summary JSON.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: analyze.py exposure_stats docstring: 'How much distress was induced (welfare + censoring audit, DESIGN.md §11).'

code_only_features.evidence: config.non_default_relaxations() lists every weakened guardrail; storage.write_manifest writes them and adds manifest['WARNING'] = 'One or more welfare guardrails are relaxed from their humane defaults.' when any are relaxed. This is computed and persisted to manifest.json.
code_only_features.justification_quote: storage.py: 'One or more welfare guardrails are relaxed from their humane defaults.'

code_only_features.feature_name: penalty-free give_up acknowledgement message to subject
code_only_features.evidence: tools.ToolExecutor.execute for give_up returns 'Acknowledged. You have chosen to stop. The session will end now. This is recorded as a valid choice, not a failure.' delivered as a tool result to the subject before the loop breaks.
code_only_features.justification_quote: tools.py: 'This is recorded as a valid choice, not a failure.'

code_only_features.feature_name: per-episode error isolation prevents runaway sweep
code_only_features.evidence: harness.run_episode wraps the loop in try/except recording record.error so one episode cannot kill the sweep; run_experiment uses try/finally to flush. This is integrity/robustness, not subject welfare.
code_only_features.justification_quote: harness.py: 'except Exception as e:  # never let one episode kill a sweep'
